views.reconstructed_statement: For every type iota in universe u with decidable equality, every A and B of type CMatrix iota iota, and every complex N, let P = eq29PrintedClean A B N, Q = eq29PhaseBalancedClean A B N, and R = S1 A B. Four assertions hold together. (1) For every i, P(inr i, inr i) = -N and R(inr i, inr i) = 0. (2) If iota is nonempty and N is nonzero, P and R are unequal as matrices. (3) For every i and j, Q(inr i, inr j) = 0, Q(inl i, inl j) = P(inl i, inl j), Q(inl i, inr j) = P(inl i, inr j), and Q(inr i, inl j) = P(inr i, inl j). (4) If IsHermitian B, then Q = R as matrices.

quantifiers: Universal over iota : Type u, with a DecidableEq iota instance.
Universal over A, B : CMatrix iota iota and N : Complex.
Conjunct 1 separately quantifies every i : iota. Conjunct 3 separately quantifies every ordered pair i, j : iota.
assumptions: DecidableEq iota is in scope for the entire conjunction.
Nonempty iota and N != 0 are successive premises of conjunct 2.
IsHermitian B is the premise of conjunct 4.
conventions: P, Q, and R are notation for the imported operations applied to the exact arguments shown.
Entry arguments preserve the displayed order. inl and inr are the injections of the two summands.
The right-right block in conjunct 3 ranges over all i and j, including i = j. Conjunct 1 concerns only the right-right diagonal.
conjuncts: Two unconditional right-right diagonal equalities for each i, one for P and one for R.
Conditional whole-matrix inequality between P and R.
One unconditional zero block for Q and three unconditional entrywise block agreements between Q and P.
Conditional whole-matrix equality between Q and R.

views.reconstructed_statement: Both of the following hold. (1) For every iota : Type u and kappa : Type v with Fintype iota, Fintype kappa and DecidableEq kappa, for every S, T : CMatrix iota iota and X : CMatrix kappa kappa, if IsHermitian S, IsHermitian T, and IsHermitian X, then IsHermitian (add (tensor S X) (tensor T (identity kappa))). (2) There exist n and m in the natural numbers, S and T in CMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n), and X in CMatrix (Fin m) (Fin m), such that IsHermitian S, IsHermitian T, not IsHermitian X, and not IsHermitian (add (tensor S X) (tensor T (identity (Fin m)))).

quantifiers: The left conjunct universally binds iota : Type u, kappa : Type v, the three listed instances, S, T : CMatrix iota iota, and X : CMatrix kappa kappa.
The right conjunct independently existentially binds n, m : Nat, S, T : CMatrix (Fin n) (Fin n), and X : CMatrix (Fin m) (Fin m). No explicit inequality or positivity premise on n or m is displayed.
assumptions: The universal assertion uses Fintype instances for both index types and a DecidableEq instance for kappa.

The universal implication has three successive Hermiticity premises, for S, T and X. In the existential assertion, Hermiticity of S and T and non-Hermiticity of X are requirements on the same witnesses as the non-Hermitian result.
conventions: The first term is tensor S X and the second is tensor T with the identity on the X index type.
IsHermitian is the imported predicate. add, tensor and identity are the imported matrix operations in the displayed operand order.
conjuncts: A universal sufficient condition for the sum of the two tensors to satisfy IsHermitian.
A finite-dimensional instance where S and T satisfy IsHermitian and both X and the sum of the two tensors fail IsHermitian.
